title: 3Sum
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return all the unique triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j`, `i != k`, and `j != k`, and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`.

Print each unique triplet on a new line with elements sorted.
input_format:
The first line contains `N`, the number of elements.
The second line contains `N` space-separated integers.
output_format: Print each unique triplet sorted space-separated on a new line.

sample_tests.explanation: Distinct triplets summing to 0 are [-1, -1, 2] and [-1, 0, 1].
